的确，人工智能的“阅读”效率远超人类: Indeed, artificial intelligence's "reading" efficiency far exceeds that of humans

今天看来，的确，“书”的形态变了，但别想摆脱阅读，哪怕我们有了人工智能: Looking at it today, indeed, the form of 'books' has changed, but don't think of escaping reading, even though we now have artificial intelligence.
